exposure: microbiological profile of bacterial bloodstream infection
cohort: The participants were neonates admitted to a level III neonatal unit in South India who had culture-positive bacterial sepsis with a single known pathogenic organism in blood culture.
finding: The study identified temporal changes in microbial patterns and antibiotic sensitivity in neonatal sepsis, showing an increase in resistance to first-line antibiotics and the emergence of multidrug-resistant strains over time.
